answer: The lagoon assignment is published and onyx records each panel. The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the jetty graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1255 impostors cost 1348 times the honest price and take 25 times as long to clear.
